title: On Buying the field from the widow
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：buy　|　正文 345 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 buy 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1986 the craftsman ① bought the field from the widow in the rain, and every apprentice in the workshop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the craftsman ② buys the field from the widow without complaint without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ buy the field from the widow at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ bought the field from the widow before — a line in the ledger for August 1980 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Buying the field from the widow in the rain, the craftsman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the tool at the far bench, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ buy that story about the money without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Buy that story about the money at once and never mention it again.

By 1993 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the ledger, and a new apprentice from the next workshop ⑧ buys that story about the money in the rain every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bench, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ bought the field from the widow again when nobody else would.

⑩ To buy the field from the widow, my mother said in 1998, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the workshop remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the workshop forgets, somebody buys the field from the widow without complaint again and somebody must buy the field from the widow in the rain all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 买下（一般过去式 bought the field from the widow：1986 年匠人头一回这样做，淋着雨）
B. v. 买下（一般现在 buys the field from the widow：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 买下（不定式 to buy the field from the widow：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 买下（过去完成时 had bought the field from the widow：1980 年八月的工料簿上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 买下（动名词 buying the field from the widow 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 相信（buy that story about the money：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去相信钱的那套说法）
G. v. 相信（buy that story about the money：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 买下（后段两处：新来的学徒照例 buys that story about the money，而母亲又一次 bought the field from the widow）

buy 意为“买下”，自那以后匠人毫无怨言地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 buys。
buy 意为“买下”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯买下从寡妇手里买下那块地”，此处为不定式 to buy the field from the widow。
buy 意为“买下”，工料簿里 八月 那行字说明早在 1993 年之前就有人买下过，故用过去完成时 had bought。
buy 意为“买下”，匠人说“买下从寡妇手里买下那块地这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 buying the field from the widow 作主语。
buy 意为“相信”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去相信钱的那套说法”，should ever 之后用原形 buy that story about the money。
buy 意为“相信”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻相信钱的那套说法（buy that story about the money at once），以后再也不要提起。
buy 意为“买下”，新来的学徒每个年头都照例相信钱的那套说法，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 buys。
buy 意为“买下”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次淋着雨买下从寡妇手里买下那块地，用一般过去式 bought 叙述。
buy 意为“买下”，结尾那句是母亲 1998 年的话：要买下从寡妇手里买下那块地，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和工坊记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 buy 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1986 the craftsman bought the field from the widow in the rain, and nobody in the workshop forgot it.
Even now the craftsman buys the field from the widow without complaint whenever the workshop asks.
Buying the field from the widow in the rain, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever buy that story about the money without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new apprentice from the next workshop buys that story about the money in the rain every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother bought the field from the widow again, and the workshop remembered that half.
